query: I have this AsyncAPI spec at `evals/fixtures/order.asyncapi.yaml`. What Drift tests should I write for the `sendOrderCreated` operation?
expected_behavior: Triggers the asyncapi-parser skill (not the drift-testing skill) to handle spec analysis
Identifies the operation action as 'send' and determines the execution mode as async-observe
Produces an analysis section stating: 1 operation, action: send, channel: drift.examples.order-created, mode: async-observe, payload has const fields (eventType, status) — 1 test variant
Generates a Drift operations YAML block with exactly one operation named SendOrderCreated_Observe (or similar convention-following name)
The generated operation includes a trigger block with executable-type: command and parameters propagating ${parameters.correlation-id}
The generated operation includes an expected block with headers.correlation-id and payload fields including eventType: order.created and status: created
The target field follows the 3-part format: <source>:sendOrderCreated:orderCreated
